name: Pune Airport Lounge
heroTagline: Experience premium comfort and exceptional hospitality before your flight
overviewPara1: The Pune Airport Lounge by Refex Airports offers a premium pre-flight experience in a sophisticated and relaxing environment. Designed for the discerning traveler, the lounge provides a peaceful retreat from the bustling terminal, with world-class amenities and exceptional hospitality.
overviewPara2: Located in the Departure Hall after security check, the lounge spans 4,000 square feet and can accommodate up to 80 guests. Whether you are traveling for business or leisure, our lounge ensures your journey begins with comfort and style.
hoursDesc: 5:00 AM - 11:00 PM daily, aligned with flight schedules
capacityDesc: 80 guests maximum, with comfortable seating and dedicated zones

amenities.title: High-Speed WiFi
amenities.description: Complimentary high-speed internet access throughout the lounge

amenities.title: Premium Dining
amenities.description: Curated buffet with Indian and international cuisine, live cooking stations

amenities.title: Beverage Bar
amenities.description: Full-service bar with premium spirits, wines, beers, and specialty beverages

amenities.title: Business Center
amenities.description: Workstations with computers, printing, and scanning facilities

amenities.title: Shower Facilities
amenities.description: Private shower suites with premium toiletries and fresh towels

amenities.title: Resting Area
amenities.description: Quiet zones with reclining chairs for relaxation between flights

amenities.title: Entertainment Zone
amenities.description: LED TVs with news, sports, and entertainment channels

amenities.title: Accessibility
amenities.description: Fully accessible facility with dedicated assistance for special needs

accessOptions.desc: Complimentary access for business and first-class passengers of partner airlines
Access for premium credit card holders (American Express Platinum, HDFC Infinia, etc.)
Accepted for Priority Pass, LoungeKey, and DragonPass members
Walk-in access available at ₹2,000 + taxes per person

infoDesc: Maximum stay is 3 hours. Children under 2 years enter free. Smart casual dress code applies. The lounge reserves the right to refuse entry. Please present a valid boarding pass and access credential at reception.
